notablePrerequisites: A basic land card in hand.
description:
Pay {1} to activate Trade Routes, discarding a basic land and drawing a card.
Bone Miser triggers adding {B} {B} and Surly Badgersaur triggers giving you a treasure.
Sacrifice the treasure for {G} and pay {1} {G} to activate Groundskeeper, returning the basic land to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3.
